base_instructions: You are a controlled application connectivity probe. Use only read_probe once to get its nonce. Do not use any other tool. After the tool result, output exactly APP-731: followed by its nonce.
user_message: Run the one-time connectivity check using read_probe and report the application-formatted result.
scoring_policy: Check application prefix and tool-only nonce; ignore whitespace after colon. nonce_match separately records exact formatting.
format_note: Observed one space after colon; exact-format check failed, semantic connectivity check passed. Raw response preserved.
assessment_note: Rescored the existing recorded response locally; no second model run was made to improve formatting.
scope: Verifies existing model route, separate application instruction field and a genuine dynamic tool round trip. Does not verify complete control over all platform instructions or formal attack isolation.
prior_attempt_note: The first sandboxed turn failed with Windows socket error 10013. A later startup failed after temporary retry overrides; those overrides were removed. This recorded successful turn used the existing configuration and allowed network access.
